info.title: diffd
info.description: Reviews of code changes, between an agent and you.

get.summary: Everything the page needs to show a review.

delete.summary: Delete a review, its threads and its history.

get.summary: One file outside the diff, highlighted.
Every file in the review's repository, for browsing beyond the diff.
The diff between two points in a review's history.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: A commit; omitted for the working tree.

get.summary:
Long-poll until the user leaves feedback an agent here should hear about
(200, with the notice), or the wait ends (204). Used by `diffd hook`.

parameters.name: cwd
parameters.description: The agent's working directory: reviews of that repository wake it.

parameters.name: waiter
parameters.description: The harness session, e.g. `claude:<session id>`; a newer wait replaces an older one.

204.description: The wait ended with nothing to say

delete.summary: Stop waiting for this waiter (its session ended).

ActivityItem.description: One entry in the page's activity feed.

Anchor.description: Where a thread lives: a line range on one side of a file.

text.description: The exact anchored text, used to follow the lines across revisions.

oneOf.description:
Set when the comment was written while looking at part of the review's
history (one commit, or a few) rather than the whole diff.

Boot.description: What the server embeds in each page it serves; the page renders from it.

oneOf.description:
Start a thread on a selection. The page picks the ids, so sending the
same message twice (e.g. after a reconnect) has no extra effect.
The user opened or closed a comment draft; open drafts hold feedback back.
A message in the chat box.
The user has seen activity up to `seq`.

Ask a language server about a position in a file on the new side
(line 1-based, column in UTF-16 code units). Answered with `ServerMsg::Code`.
Markdown, as the server wrote it.
No language server for this file (or it couldn't answer): fall back to what the page knows.

CodeLocation.description:
Where a language server points: a file in the repository (a relative
path), or outside it (an absolute path, e.g. a library's source).

CodeQuery.description: What the page can ask a language server about a position.

Commit.description: A commit between the review's two sides.

CommitRange.description: Two points in a review's history: commits, or the working tree for `to: null`.

Diagnostic.description:
A language server's error or warning on the new side of a file.
Lines are 1-based; columns count UTF-16 code units from 0, as in the page.

source.description: The tool that reported it, e.g. `rustc`, `pyright`.

FileDiff.description: One file's diff: both sides in full, aligned line by line.

language.description: Display name of the language, when we recognise it.

oneOf.description: Why the contents aren't shown, when they aren't.

details.description:
Changes the rows can't show: the file mode, line endings, the final
newline, a submodule's commit. Short phrases, e.g. "mode 100644 → 100755".

collapsed.description: Why the file starts collapsed (set by the agent, e.g. "generated by ts-rs").

labels.description: What kind of file it is, as diffd can tell by itself: `test`, `generated`.

rows.description: The whole file, aligned: (old line index, new line index), 0-based.

since.description: New-side lines (1-based) that changed since the previous revision.

Group.description:
A chapter of the agent's guided tour: files that change together for one
reason, read one after another.

title.description: What these changes are, in a few words, e.g. "The rate limiter API" or "Database migrations".

summary.description: One or two plain sentences on what changed here and why, shown above the chapter's code.

files.description: Files in the diff, as paths, directories or globs (`web/src/**`, `*.sql`), in reading order.

History.description:
The commits a review spans, oldest first along first parents, so the page
can walk them one at a time or diff any two.

base.description: The commit the review compares against.

worktree.description: The review ends at the working tree, so uncommitted changes follow the last commit.

truncated.description: Only the newest commits are listed.

Label.description: A label on some files (e.g. `frontend`), which the user can hide.

files.description: Paths, directories or globs, e.g. `web/**` or `*.sqlx`.

Layout.description:
How the agent arranged the review for reading: who it is, related changes
grouped together, and labels the user can hide files by.

agent.description: The agent's name as its harness gives it, e.g. "Claude" or "Codex".

LiveState.description:
[`ReviewState`] without the snapshot: what a page that already has the
current revision needs when its socket (re)connects. A big review's
snapshot is megabytes, and the page already holds it.

Message.description: A message in a thread, or in the chat.

oneOf.description: When the agent received it (user messages only).

MessageId.description: One message in a thread or in the chat.

Omitted.description: Why a file's contents aren't shown.

Presence.description: What the agent is doing, as far as the page can tell.

Region.description: A range the agent labelled when sharing: tests, or code folded behind a summary.

lines.description: 1-based inclusive line range; `None` means the whole file.

summary.description: For folds: what changed in there, in plain language.

text.description: The anchored text, used to follow the lines across revisions.

ReviewId.description: A review: one shared diff and its conversation.

ReviewState.description:
Everything the page needs to render a review. It's embedded in the HTML so
the page works offline, and sent again when the socket (re)connects from a
page without the current revision (otherwise it gets [`LiveState`]).

regions.description: Tests and folds the agent marked.

layout.description: Who the agent is, and how it grouped and labelled the files.

history.description: The commits in the review's range.

readSeq.description: Activity up to this sequence number has been seen by the user.

diagnostics.description: Language servers' diagnostics, by path (files in the diff and open for context).

ReviewSummary.description: A review in the recent list on the home page.

unread.description: Agent activity the user hasn't seen.

items.description: An aligned pair of 0-based line indices; `None` where one side has no line.

Row.description: An aligned pair of 0-based line indices; `None` where one side has no line.

oneOf.description: Full state, sent on connect, and to a page that can't apply a `revision`.

Sent on connect instead of `State` when the page already has the
current revision (the socket's URL says which one it has).
A new revision of the diff, as changes to the one before.
The agent's region labels changed.
The agent regrouped or relabelled the files.
A thread was created or changed.
A file's diagnostics changed (an empty list clears them).
The answer to a `ClientMsg::Code` question.
New commits landed in the review's range.
The agent wants to point the user at some code.
The server applied the page's message with this id (see [`ClientMsg`]).
A request from the page failed.
The review no longer exists (it was deleted): stop reconnecting.

Severity.description: How bad a language server's diagnostic is.

syntax.description:
Per line, flattened `[start, end, class, start, end, class, …]`.
`class` indexes [`SyntaxClass::ALL`].

novel.description: Per line, flattened `[start, end, …]`: tokens difftastic marks as novel.

Snapshot.description: Everything the page needs to render one revision of a review.

SnapshotDelta.description:
A revision as changes to the one before it. An agent editing one file of
a big review would otherwise resend every file (megabytes) on each save.

paths.description:
Every file's path, in the new order. Paths not in `files` are the
base's files, unchanged; base files missing here are gone.

files.description: Files that are new or differ in any way from the base's.

symbols.description: The definitions in `files`, with `file` indexing the new order.

Symbol.description: A definition found by the tags queries: what `gd` jumps to.

lines.description: The whole definition's first and last line (1-based), e.g. a function with its body.

oneOf.description: The anchored code changed after the thread started, in this revision.

outdated.description: The anchored code can no longer be found.

ThreadId.description: A thread of messages anchored to lines, or an agent note.

oneOf.description: Started by the user on a selection.
An annotation the agent wrote when sharing; `order` is its place in the tour.

WakeNotice.description: What woke the agent, and what to tell it.

message.description: Addressed to the agent: what happened and what to do.
